packageRules.description: The image name in this file is assembled from a build argument, so a pinned digest would only ever resolve for one of the PHP versions in the test matrix.

'scripts/provision.sh' copies these constraints into the fixture site, where Drupal core caps both below their latest release: 'drupal/core-recommended' pins 'justinrainbow/json-schema' to '~6.8.2', and 'drupal/core-dev' pins PHPUnit to 11, which 'dvdoug/behat-code-coverage' 5.5 does not support. Raising either floor makes the fixture unresolvable.
